title: Editor E3 instrument: the visual suite can photograph a member's Spotlight and a Space's Site
detail: E3's gate is zero visual diff across Spotlight, in-app profile, Space and Site, and none of them had a baseline. editorTargetSurfaces in test/e2e/surfaces.ts adds an anonymous first-screen surface for /spotlight/<PW_SPOTLIGHT_HANDLE> and /sites/<PW_SITE_SLUG>, joins the coverage union, and e2e-manual.yml passes both repo variables. With neither set the suite is unchanged. Nothing is photographed until the owner sets the two variables and runs the capture. The in-app profile and Space profile baselines are not part of this slice.

verify.note: Fails while the visual suite declares no Spotlight or Site surface.
